facts.fact: The Angolan Data Protection Agency (APD) published, under article 53(3) of Law 22/11, its Board of Directors' deliberations 004/2024 and 005/2024 of 19 July 2024, showing the Agency acting.

By deliberations 004/2024 and 005/2024 of 19 July 2024 the APD fined COSAL the equivalent of US$75,000 and ENDE-EP the equivalent of US$225,000 for failing to protect personal data against ransomware attacks of September 2023.
The Angolan Data Protection Agency (APD) published, under article 53(3) of Law 22/11, its Board of Directors' deliberations 004/2024 and 005/2024 of 19 July 2024, showing the Agency acting.
The APD's 19 July 2024 notice fines two organisations for violating the personal data protection rules of Law 22/11 of 17 June, showing the law in force.

By deliberations 004/2024 and 005/2024 of 19 July 2024 the APD fined COSAL the equivalent of US$75,000 and ENDE-EP the equivalent of US$225,000 for failing to protect personal data against ransomware attacks of September 2023.
